title: The forest moves.
note: DRAFT: the sow_ridge cells are placeholders; pick 3-5 adjacent cells across the route after a dry run of seed 4242. Act break = drift 26.
captions: After every boss, the Heartwood gives you a gift.
This one raises a ridge of dead trees.
The route bends around it. The long way now.
A new map every run, and you get to change it.
